chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the milk of the bull (sire), so he said: 'It is when your wife nurses from your milk and the milk of your son who is the son of another woman, then it is forbidden.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of laban al-fahl regarding marital prohibitions in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar clarifies the mechanism of 'laban al-fahl' (milk of the sire), where a woman’s nursing from a man’s son establishes a mahram relationship between her and the father, effectively creating a prohibition akin to direct nursing. This ruling is pivotal in Shia fiqh for expanding the scope of consanguinity through milk, ensuring that marital unions are prevented based on these extended familial bonds. The narration underscores the practical application of Quranic principles regarding milk kinship in determining lineage and marriage eligibility.
